plan.notes: SOURCE: Official NDSU University Catalog 2024-2025. Semester sequence transcribed from the 'B.S. Calculus Ready 4-Year Plan' on the official Computer Science programs-study page; course titles verified against the official B.S. Computer Science requirements table (undergraduate/program-curriculum/computer-science). HONESTY NOTE: NDSU labels these 'Sample Program Guide' with a disclaimer that they are not the official curriculum for current students and individual plans vary by start year, transfer credit, and course availability; students use Degree Map and advisors. This is the only semester-by-semester sequence NDSU publishes for the B.S. The major requires one 12-credit track (Standard, Cybersecurity, Data Science, or Software Engineering); the plan's 'CSCI 277 or MATH 129' slot plus CSCI Electives I-III correspond to the track credits. STAT 368 recorded at 3 credits per the plan (requirements list 3 or 5).
